items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: And who was this guy, Wright, that played tenor sax? He was a couple by Tredd, he played tenor sax or something.

ctx.x: the other day? Alexis. Is that his name, Alexis Rochon? Alexis Rochon. And what instrument did he play?
Sax. He was a good man on the sax. And who was this guy, Wright, that played tenor sax? He was a couple by Tredd, he played tenor sax or something. What was it coming in?
Remember his first name? Maybe Alba.
